methodology.instrumentation: stdlib only; capture_session uses installed skill_lens runtime
methodology.tracing: tracemalloc.start() BEFORE old generation exists; baseline read after start; gc.collect before each current reading; reset_peak immediately before refresh; retained_heap_* = CURRENT traced allocations (old held / both held); peak_traced_* = transient peaks reported separately; excludes RSS/native; refuses to run if tracemalloc is already active (fresh-subprocess precondition)
methodology.refresh: untraced initial + refresh captures keep generation 1 alive through refresh (raw capture_session overlap, simulated refresh, not controller pipeline); both released before traced runs; snap_old/snap_new released before AFTER fingerprint
methodology.fingerprint: os.walk with onerror callback that raises OSError (no silently skipped traversal failures); chunked SHA-256 per regular file before/after; directories incl. modes; symlink targets recorded without following; walk/stat/read errors raise, never silently skipped
methodology.assertions: compact validator LOOP over initial/refresh/old/new: exact captured_file_count, captured_payload_bytes, captured_largest_file_bytes, canonical_keys AND correct generation for each; old/new distinct objects; per-file bytes object identity for nonempty assets; per-file captured SHA-256 compared to fixture hash; enforced, fail nonzero
methodology.preservation: checked AFTER releasing snapshot temporaries (including snap_old/snap_new), tracing off

conditions.fixture_cache: Warm OS page cache likely; cold disk may vary.
